sections.title: Morning Shift (06:50 – 14:30)
items: Equipment handover: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras plus 1 Charger.
Morning shift deployed. Commencing patrol towards Aotea Square with welfare checks along the way.
Queen Street Starbucks, Localito, McDonald's, and 77 Convenience Store all clear. Heading to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Commencing sweep.
Area all clear; standing by to show presence.
Heading up Wellesley Street towards Federal Street.
Skytower area, 77 Convenience Store, and cafe all clear. Standing by to show presence.
St Patrick's Cathedral Church all clear.
Albert Mart Convenience Store all clear.
Bus interchange, Lower Albert Street, all clear.
Commercial Bay full sweep around Reign and Pour and surrounds all clear. TK Square all clear. Standing by for calls.
Commencing full Queen Street sweep towards Aotea Square.
Aotea Square full sweep all clear. Standing by for calls.
Heading on Queen Street towards Britomart. Vulcan Lane all clear. Standing by for calls.
Customs Street all clear. Heading to Fort Lane.
Fort Lane, Gore Street, Wilson Car Park and surrounds all clear. Standing by for calls.
Pioneer Women's Memorial Hall check all clear.
Chancery Square full sweep all clear. Standing by for calls.
Heading to Aotea Square via Queen Street sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep all clear. Standing by for calls.
Heading on Queen Street for a thorough sweep towards Britomart.
Welfare checks done on businesses incl. OPSM, Kathmandu, Macpac, Chemist Warehouse — all clear. Standing by at McDonald's Queen Street at TK Square.
Heading to HQ for lunch break, sweeping Queen Street.
Queen Street all clear. Standing by near Starbucks figuring out office access.
At HQ having lunch break; standing by for calls.
Standing by at HQ for shift handover and calls.
Morning shift completed. All clear, no issues to report.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:39 – 06:30)
items: Equipment handover: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras plus 1 Charger.
Received call from management to stand by at Take10.
On our way to stand by at Take10.
Arrived at Take10, standing by showing presence.
Received a call from a fellow guard at Bar101 for a potential brawl; one guard standing by at Take10.
Arrived at Bar101; notified the group of individuals had left the premises and would come back. Standing by at Bar101 showing presence.
Removed alcohol from a female individual.
Confiscated alcohol from a male individual.
Confiscated alcohol from a group of adults. No issues.
Welfare check Bar101 all clear, no further issues.
Heading back to office to commence floor checks.
Floor checks complete. Standing by in office to charge Ops phone due to low percentage.
Patrolling through Britomart, Kong manager requested assistance with a female adult (approx. 40s) refusing to leave Kong; Police have been called.
Kindly asked her to leave but she would not comply and was very aggressive.
Police arrived; standing by for any assistance needed.
Female has left the premises. All clear, no further issues.
Showing presence in Britomart for public safety.
Welfare check Reign n Pour all clear, no further issues.
Received a response call from Kong regarding an aggressive female adult causing disturbance in the area.
Arrived at Kong; intoxicated female adult still present on premises, asked kindly to leave the site.
Female individual has left the area. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check Sapphire Nightclub all clear, no issues.
Received a response call from a fellow guard regarding the recent incident of 3 minors (2 male, 1 female) causing disturbance to Bar101 staff and security.
Arrived at Bar101; notified they had left the matter. Standing by showing presence.
Bar101 no issues; group causing trouble earlier did not show face again.
Response call for Britomart Maccas due to an individual being verbally aggressive with his order.

Arrived on site; big group outside Commercial Bay. Witnessed many getting king-hit by a young male individual. Intervened, separated both parties, and assisted Kong guards in removing one party from the other.
Parties have been separated; guards keeping parties apart. No further issues.
Heading back to HQ, letting up guard grab belongings.
Check-in Queen Street Maccas, no issues to report.
Check-in Aotea Square, all clear, no issues.
Check-in corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener Street, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Fort Street / Wilson Carpark complete, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Gore Street, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Britomart Maccas / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ for changeover.

Serious / notable: Commercial Bay group assault — young male king-hitting people, HOTC intervened and separated parties, assisted Kong guards (04:06, photos/video on file). Two aggressive/intoxicated female incidents at Kong Britomart, one with Police attendance (02:05, 02:54). Three alcohol confiscations on Queen Street (23:59, 00:13, 00:28).
